2. There is a delay of 33 days in filing the 
present appeal from order.
3. Heard.
4. Issue notice to the respondents on delay 
condonation application. Steps to be taken 
within a week.
5. List this matter on 31.10.2025.
6. Meanwhile, LCR be summoned.
7. Also heard on the Stay Application (IA 
No. 2 of 2025).
8. Learned counsel for the appellant 
submits that execution of proceedings is going 
on and he seeks four weeks’ time to deposit 
the entire awarded amount, excluding the 
statutory deposit, with the Tribunal 
concerned.
9. Having considered the submission of 
learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed 
that the effect and operation of the impugned 
award dated 23.04.2025 passed by M.A.C.T., 
Khatima/Additional District Judge, Khatima, 
District Udham Singh Nagar in Claim Petition 
No. 20 of 2023 shall remain stayed, provided 
the applicant/appellant deposits the entire 
awarded amount, excluding the statutory 
deposit, with the Tribunal concerned within a 
period of four weeks from today. (Stay 
application is disposed of).

submits that the appellant has deposited

circumstances of the case, money

Registry is directed to release 50% of 
the deposited amount, proportionately in 
favour of claimants/respondent nos.1 & 
2, without asking any security. The 
remaining amount shall be invested in an 
interest bearing scheme of a nationalized  bank.
6. Money withdrawal application (I.A.

7. List on 12.12.2025.

AO No. 306 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat for the appellant.
None is present for the respondent.
The appellant proposes to challenge the 
judgment and order dated 23.04.2025, passed 
in MACP No. 20 of 2023, Smt. Kavita Devi 
Shahi and another vs. Sri Sandeep Kumar 
Bisht and others (“the claim petition”), by the 
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/Additional 
District Judge, Khatima, District Udham Singh 
Nagar. By it, the respondents/claimants were 
awarded Rs.11,32,400/- as compensation 
alongwith interest @ 6 % from the date of filing 
of the claim petition. It is delayed.
Heard on Delay Condonation Application 
No. 1 of 2025.
Having heard, this Court is of the view 
that there are good grounds to condone the 
delay.
Delay condonation application is allowed.
Delay in filing the appeal is condoned.
Admit.
Call for the LCR.
List on 23.07.2026 for final hearing.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 15.05.2026
Jitendra

Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia, Advocate for 
the appellant in AO No.419 of 2025.
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the 
appellant in AO No.306 of 2025.
It is argued on behalf of the appellant in 
AO No.419 of 2025 that the deceased had an 
Income Tax Return on 19.11.2021, but his 
compensation has not been assessed based 
on that Income Tax Return, instead, based 
on the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, 
calculation has been made. It is also 
submitted that, in fact, the death took place 
on 14.11.2022.
Fact remains that in the claim petition, 
the claimants have shown the monthly 
income of the deceased as Rs. 25,000/-. 
When confronted as to why compensation
beyond Rs.25,000/- may be assessed, 
learned counsel for the appellant seeks time. 
List this matter on 13.08.2026, along 
with the connected appeal. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
23.07.2026
RV
